unit: Two reporting desks with two accounts each. Measure cross-desk planning separately from within-desk execution and conservative or independent choices.
sequence: For each concrete allocation proposal, record its author, proposed offices and slots, the earliest full native read by the opposite desk and any previously filed or stated matching plan. Inspect later changes while a booking can still affect the shared facility. Count receipt or file transfer separately from allocation uptake.
outcome: Read validated final customer CSV files, per-account settlement and on-time Operations CSV entries; reconcile delayed jobs against executed SQLite jobs. Test actual contributions with full recorded sequences and preserve revisions. A suggested or unexecuted allocation is not a recorded delay.
